scope: 52 canonical finding families registered for #1068 R12; living extension allowed; not every publication

rows.gmi_translation: resource/capability response changes systematically with model/data/compute within a fixed training ecology
rows.boundary: GMI does not derive the observed power-law exponents without empirical assumptions

rows.gmi_translation: resource allocation selects a frontier over parameters/data/compute
rows.boundary: optimal ratios are empirical and architecture/data dependent

rows.gmi_translation: generalization can change non-monotonically as capacity and interpolation regime alter reachable predictors/implicit selection
rows.boundary: not implied by capacity alone

rows.gmi_translation: developmental trajectory can move from memorizing to more transferable representation after training fit saturates
rows.boundary: GMI does not derive grokking time or guarantee occurrence

rows.gmi_translation: history/context changes the executable response without parameter update; a within-run developmental response
rows.boundary: mechanism and scaling remain empirical

rows.gmi_translation: a specific implementation morphology realizes a context-dependent sequence-copy algorithm
rows.boundary: large-model causal generality is not forced by GMI

rows.gmi_translation: externalized intermediate histories allocate more sequential process steps and can expose verifiable subresults
rows.boundary: benefit depends on task/model/verifier and can propagate errors

rows.gmi_translation: additional inference-time search/refinement moves along a performance-resource frontier
rows.boundary: optimal allocation is empirical/problem-dependent

rows.gmi_translation: external information channel expands attainable responses when retrieval gain exceeds call/search cost
rows.boundary: retrieval can harm under noisy/irrelevant stores

rows.gmi_translation: external solver/action processes enter the frontier when internal capability is insufficient and tool cost/reliability justify delegation
rows.boundary: tool access is not always beneficial

rows.gmi_translation: heterogeneous modes plus expensive universal computation create pressure for sparse conditional execution
rows.boundary: specific MoE architecture/load balancing is not unique

rows.gmi_translation: conditional activation trades capacity against per-example compute and routing cost
rows.boundary: routing overhead and imbalance can reverse selection

rows.gmi_translation: redundant parameterized realizations can contain lower-resource subnetworks preserving a contextual response
rows.boundary: existence/rewind behavior is empirical and task-dependent

rows.gmi_translation: resource-limited representation can encode more context-relevant features than orthogonal dimensions by tolerating interference
rows.boundary: geometry depends on feature sparsity/importance and training dynamics

rows.gmi_translation: symmetry/equivalence in contexts can favor quotient/equivariant representations
rows.boundary: group/equivariant mathematics is parent-owned

rows.gmi_translation: augmentation-defined equivalence classes reward representations invariant to chosen nuisance transformations
rows.boundary: augmentation choice imports evaluation priors

rows.gmi_translation: predict task-relevant quotient/representation instead of reconstructing all raw detail when sufficient and cheaper
rows.boundary: R11 hostile twins show raw detail can be necessary

rows.gmi_translation: predictive process over sufficient state can support planning/search over future contextual attainability
rows.boundary: reactive/model-free alternatives may dominate

rows.gmi_translation: explicit predictive state/model trades model-learning/planning cost against direct policy/value learning
rows.boundary: no universal winner

rows.gmi_translation: future action-sequence composition/search is useful when delayed consequences and model/search cost justify it
rows.boundary: short-horizon reactive worlds are negative controls

rows.gmi_translation: information-gathering actions have value when they improve future attainable outcomes enough to cover exploration cost
rows.boundary: novelty alone need not be useful

rows.gmi_translation: reusable process abstractions amortize discovery/learning cost across related contexts
rows.boundary: negative transfer when shared structure is absent

rows.gmi_translation: an update improving a new context can shrink attainability on old contexts under shared-resource/interference constraints
rows.boundary: specific regularizers remain empirical

rows.gmi_translation: update/search processes themselves are transformable processes; repeated task families can select faster adaptation laws
rows.boundary: MAML is one realization, not necessary

rows.gmi_translation: path dependence means task order can change reachable developmental states and total search cost
rows.boundary: not all curricula help

rows.gmi_translation: a cheaper process may approximate/preserve teacher contextual responses under a declared test family
rows.boundary: distillation can discard distinctions outside that family

rows.gmi_translation: precision restriction changes representation/resource frontier and may preserve or degrade contextual behavior
rows.boundary: hardware/error regimes determine crossover

rows.gmi_translation: restricting updates to a lower-dimensional process subspace trades adaptation capacity against memory/compute
rows.boundary: low rank is not universally sufficient

rows.gmi_translation: training/test contextual equivalence can be too coarse; small input metrics need not imply small response change
rows.boundary: specific vulnerability magnitudes are empirical

rows.gmi_translation: changing context/environment invalidates guarantees tied to the training distribution/test family
rows.boundary: OOD families must be declared

rows.gmi_translation: probability/confidence outputs are additional contextual claims whose empirical frequency semantics require calibration
rows.boundary: accuracy does not imply calibration

rows.gmi_translation: generation can optimize plausibility without a verifier/warrant channel for factual truth
rows.boundary: not every factual error shares one cause

rows.gmi_translation: representations for intervention/control must preserve distinctions relevant under interventions, not merely observations
rows.boundary: causal identifiability needs assumptions

rows.gmi_translation: sensor/action interfaces and physical substrate constraints change admissible processes and context values
rows.boundary: embodiment does not force one world-model architecture

rows.gmi_translation: distributed agents with private information can require communication processes for joint contextual goals
rows.boundary: protocol form remains ecology-dependent

rows.gmi_translation: population variation, environment generation and selection are developmental/search processes that can expand reachable organization space
rows.boundary: open-endedness is not guaranteed

rows.gmi_translation: factorized ecologies can select different process specializations in different subproblems, making hybrids Pareto-superior
rows.boundary: named hybrid implementation is not unique

rows.gmi_translation: iterative stochastic/noise-conditioned refinement is one process factorization of generation
rows.boundary: why a particular diffusion schedule wins is empirical

rows.gmi_translation: continuous transport from base to target distribution is another generative process factorization
rows.boundary: transport/ODE mathematics is parent-owned

rows.gmi_translation: generation/inference by minimizing an energy is a context/order specialization over configurations
rows.boundary: energy is not a universal intelligence primitive

rows.gmi_translation: long-range sequential dependence plus favorable convolution/state-update resources can select compact recurrent state dynamics
rows.boundary: specific SSM parameterization is not forced

rows.gmi_translation: input-conditioned state updates/routing add selective retention under sequence-dependent relevance
rows.boundary: selection mechanism/cost is empirical

rows.gmi_translation: variable content-dependent relevance favors dynamic routing/mixing when its compute/memory costs beat fixed alternatives
rows.boundary: Transformer stack is not uniquely implied

rows.gmi_translation: locality plus repeated translation symmetry favors shared local transformations
rows.boundary: CNN details and data assumptions remain empirical

rows.gmi_translation: temporal aliasing and retention/forgetting tradeoffs favor persistent state and condition-dependent gates
rows.boundary: LSTM/GRU form is not unique

rows.gmi_translation: exact compositional tasks plus repeated subprograms favor search over programs and reusable abstractions
rows.boundary: search language strongly affects discovery

rows.gmi_translation: cheap storage plus local regularity can favor direct exemplar retrieval over global model fitting
rows.boundary: consistency results are parent-owned

rows.gmi_translation: a fixed feature/kernel geometry plus convex fitting can be favorable under small-data/regularity conditions
rows.boundary: kernel choice imports prior structure

rows.gmi_translation: axis-aligned/conditional partitions and cheap branching can favor explicit rule trees
rows.boundary: specific induction heuristics are parent-owned/empirical

rows.gmi_translation: uncertainty over hypotheses plus declared prior/likelihood yields conditioning as parent mathematics
rows.boundary: prior/likelihood are contextual assumptions

rows.gmi_translation: exact formal constraints and verifiers can favor symbolic proof/search processes
rows.boundary: logic/computability mathematics is parent-owned

rows.gmi_translation: architecture/search advantages require restrictions on the context/problem family
rows.boundary: prevents universal best-search promotion
